queries: Anthropic multi-agent research system tokens 15x more than chats
agentic coding session tokens per task vs chat orders of magnitude measurement 2026

sources_considered.why: Systematic April 2026 measurement of token use by coding agents across eight frontier models.
Reports Gartner's March 2026 estimate for agentic workflows versus chatbot queries. Secondary for the Gartner figure.
Anthropic's own token ratios for agents and multi-agent systems. From June 2025, so context only.
Gives about 30 times higher cost per interaction, but the publication date wasn't clear and it measures cost, not tokens.
Secondary summary of the arXiv paper. The primary source was used instead.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv (Bai et al., Stanford/MIT/Michigan and others)

receipt.public_excerpt: agentic tasks are uniquely expensive, consuming 1000x more tokens than code reasoning and code chat, with input tokens rather than output tokens driving the overall cost

evidence_items.explanation: For coding agents, the kind behind most enterprise tokenmaxxing, measured use is about 1,000 times code chat. That is three orders of magnitude.

evidence_items.locator: section 'Why cost per token measures the wrong thing', paragraph 3

receipt.public_excerpt: Gartner's March 2026 analysis found agentic workflows burn 5 to 30 times more tokens per task than a simple chatbot query

evidence_items.explanation: For agentic workflows in general, Gartner's estimate is 5 to 30 times a chatbot query. That is one order of magnitude at most, not several.

evidence_items.locator: section Benefits of a multi-agent system

receipt.public_excerpt: agents typically use about 4× more tokens than chat interactions, and multi-agent systems use about 15× more tokens than chats

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic's own earlier data puts agents at about 4 times chat and multi-agent systems at about 15 times. It falls outside the target period, but it fits the lower estimates.

unresolved_gaps: The Gartner figure was read through a secondary source, not the Gartner report itself.
The 1,000x figure comes from one preprint on SWE-bench coding tasks, and the baseline matters a lot.
No broad measurement of real enterprise agent use versus chat was found.
